description: In-scope vs out-of-scope intents for the facts-only assistant (Phase 0 lock).

in_scope_intents.label: Expense ratio and recurring charges
example_queries: What is the expense ratio of this fund?
What are the total expense ratio details for the direct plan?

in_scope_intents.label: Exit load and redemption charges
example_queries: What is the exit load if I redeem within a year?
Is there an exit load on this scheme?

in_scope_intents.label: Minimum SIP / lumpsum investment
example_queries: What is the minimum SIP amount?
Minimum lumpsum investment for this fund?

in_scope_intents.label: ELSS lock-in period (facts)
example_queries: What is the lock-in period for this ELSS?
How long must ELSS units stay locked in?

in_scope_intents.label: Riskometer level and benchmark index
example_queries: What is the riskometer classification?
Which benchmark does this fund follow?

in_scope_intents.label: Statements and capital gains report process (generic process, no account data)
example_queries: How do investors generally obtain capital gains statements for mutual funds?
Where can I read about mutual fund statement downloads?

out_of_scope_intents.label: Investment advice or suitability
example_queries: Should I invest in this fund?
Is this fund good for my retirement next year?
How much should I allocate to ELSS?

out_of_scope_intents.label: Comparisons, rankings, which is better
example_queries: Which HDFC fund is better for me?
HDFC Mid-Cap vs HDFC Large Cap — which wins?

out_of_scope_intents.label: Past/future return claims or performance bragging
example_queries: What return will I get in 3 years?
Will this fund beat the index next year?

out_of_scope_intents.label: User-specific account, PAN, holdings, or PII
example_queries: Here is my PAN — tell me my capital gains.
What is my current NAV for my folio?

borderline_guidance: Questions that mix factual tails with advisory prefixes (e.g. 'Should I … what is the exit load?') default to refusal or strict factual-only answer after stripping advisory framing — align with Phase 4 guardrails.
